children.text: Medial Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injuries are characterized by attenuation or rupture of the ulnar collateral ligament of the elbow leading to valgus instability in overhead throwing athletes.
Diagnosis is usually made by a combination of physical exam and MRI studies.
Treatment for most individuals is rest and physical therapy. Surgery is reserved for high level overhead athletes such as pitchers.
